newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Specialty sees 72 to 86 sfr IPO price range.
newsitem.headline: Ciba Specialty sees 72 to 86 sfr IPO price range.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals, a company being spun off by Novartis AG, said it expected the initial price range for its global public offering to be 72 to 86 Swiss francs per registered share.
The company also said it expected to offer a minimum 300 million Swiss francs worth of shares in the planned public offering. The share allocation and pricing will be announced March 13.
The transaction also consists of a 1:1 rights issue to Novartis shareholders and a rights bid, Ciba Specialty said in a statement.

Under the rights issue, holders of more than 72 million Novartis registered and bearer shares will be allotted the right to acquire one registered share of Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding for each Novartis share at a subscription price of 10 francs per share.
The total number of rights issued and the corresponding shares represent virtually 100 percent of Ciba Specialty Chemicals' issued share capital.
Rights will be eligible for trading on the Swiss Exchange from February 26 through March 11.
Subject to certain conditions, the bank syndicate will offer to buy rights from Novartis shareholders at a final Rights Price to be publicly announced before the market opens on March 11.

Novartis shareholders can either exercise their rights by subscribing for shares at 10 Swiss francs each, sell the rights at prevailing market prices or sell the rights to the bank syndicate at the Rights Bid Price, Ciba Specialty said.
Shares obtained in the Rights Bid are expected to be offered to new investors through a Global Offer. The company will not issue new shares in connection with the Global Offer.
Credit Suisse First Boston and Union Bank of Switzerland are joint Global co-ordinators of the transaction.
The planned spin-off, one of the world's largest to date, will create a specialty chemicals company with 1996 sales of more than 6.7 billion Swiss francs.
Ciba Specialty expects its shares to be listed on the Swiss Exchange and on SEAQ International in the U.K.
